dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent, and I'll be examining you today. Could you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me if it has spread anywhere else?

Actually, the rash is on my upper body and face, but I've been feeling a strange numbness and tingling in both of my palms instead. I’ve also noticed some pale, light-colored spots around my elbows that don't seem to go away.

I see. Have you noticed any loss of sensation, such as difficulty feeling heat, cold, or pain, specifically within those pale spots on your elbows? Additionally, have you noticed any thickening or lumps in the skin behind your ears or on your face?

To be honest, I haven't checked if those spots on my elbows can feel heat or cold, but they do feel quite numb when I touch them. I haven't noticed any lumps behind my ears, but I have been worried because my eyebrows seem to be thinning out and I've lost some of my eyelashes lately.
Have you noticed any muscle weakness in your hands or any thickened, rope-like nerves around your elbows or knees? REQUEST TEST: Slit-Skin_Smear

That is interesting, as leprosy-related patches are typically not itchy. Have you noticed any weakness when gripping objects or difficulty performing fine tasks with your hands? REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
RESULTS: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.
